findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "AI-Fabric-Virtual-Try-On" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Transform your look with stunning realism! Explore unique fabric styles with photo mode — whether it's the elegance of silky textures or the vibrance of bold pr…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "fashion" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: File-Upload, Get-Upload-API-Info · Private data: upload_file, File-Upload, Get-Upload-API-Info · Public sink: AI-Ring-Virtual-Try-On, AI-Watch-Virtual-Try-On, AI-Clothes-Virtual-Try-On, upload_file, File-Upload, Get-Upload-API-Info · Destructive: AI-Clothes-Virtual-Try-On, File-Upload.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: File-Upload, Get-Upload-API-Info · Private data: upload_file, File-Upload, Get-Upload-API-Info · Public sink: AI-Ring-Virtual-Try-On, AI-Watch-Virtual-Try-On, AI-Clothes-Virtual-Try-On, upload_file, File-Upload, Get-Upload-API-Info · Destructive: AI-Clothes-Virtual-Try-On, File-Upload

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
